temporal_state_chain.observed: Patricia seems more withdrawn than usual; when Jose asks, she says it is nothing really, just personal stuff, and thanks him for asking.
temporal_state_chain.belief_before: Jose regards Patricia as usually vibrant at work and has no specific knowledge of a problem troubling her.
temporal_state_chain.belief_update: Yes - he moves from no specific concern to suspecting Patricia is dealing with personal troubles she does not yet want to discuss.
temporal_state_chain.belief_after: Patricia may be troubled by personal issues and appreciates a supportive offer, but she is not ready to share details.
temporal_state_chain.intention: Be available to listen and support Patricia without pressuring her to talk.

temporal_state_chain.observed: Jose overhears Patricia on the phone worried about bills and financial commitments; she later confirms she has been overwhelmed by bills and says his offer of financial/budgeting discussion could be helpful.
temporal_state_chain.belief_before: Jose believes Patricia has unspecified personal troubles and is not ready to disclose them; he is concerned for her.
temporal_state_chain.belief_update: Yes - he now identifies financial stress as a concrete concern and learns Patricia is open to discussing budgeting help.
temporal_state_chain.belief_after: Patricia is financially overwhelmed and receptive to help with finances/budgeting; Jose's concern deepens.
temporal_state_chain.intention: Offer and be ready to discuss financial planning or budgeting tips with Patricia when she feels up to it.

temporal_state_chain.observed: Jose asks whether his financial-planning offer felt intrusive; Patricia says he was not prying and that she is grateful for his offer.
temporal_state_chain.belief_before: Jose worries he may have overstepped Patricia's boundaries by bringing up financial planning.
temporal_state_chain.belief_update: Yes - Patricia's reassurance corrects his worry; she does not view his offer as prying.
temporal_state_chain.belief_after: Patricia welcomes his support and does not think he overstepped; she appreciates him as a supportive friend.
temporal_state_chain.intention: Continue supporting Patricia as a friend while respecting her privacy.

temporal_state_chain.observed: Patricia gives a brief, polite update about a quiet weekend at home and thanks Jose when he offers to chat or help if needed.
temporal_state_chain.belief_before: Jose believes Patricia appreciates his support and has not seen him as overstepping.
temporal_state_chain.belief_update: Yes - he senses that although she appreciates his concern, she likely prefers to handle her issues privately for now.
temporal_state_chain.belief_after: Patricia values his support but seems to want privacy and is not actively seeking deeper help right now.
temporal_state_chain.emotion: understanding, respectful concern, perhaps mild disappointment
temporal_state_chain.intention: Stay available and supportive without pushing, letting Patricia initiate if she wants help or conversation.

temporal_state_chain.observed: Patricia says she is busy but handling things and thanks Jose for checking in, calling his support great; Jose reaffirms he is available.
temporal_state_chain.belief_before: Jose believes Patricia appreciates his concern but prefers to handle her issues privately.
temporal_state_chain.belief_update: No major change - Patricia's responses reinforce that she is managing and values his low-pressure support.
temporal_state_chain.belief_after: Patricia is handling her situation and appreciates Jose's ongoing supportive presence; he can continue checking in respectfully.
temporal_state_chain.intention: Continue regular low-pressure check-ins and offers of practical help, while respecting her independence and privacy.
